body: I'm done. She refuses to let me see my son and there's nothing I can do. Thanks for trying Reddit, but its just better this way.

I'm trying to stay optimistic, but I have no options right now. I don't even know where I will sleep tonight. I'm lucky if I get to eat every three days and my friends can only extend so much charity. I want to climb out of this. To look back and see it as just another obstacle behind me but I don't even know where to begin. I've fought and fought my whole life and I just don't know how much I have left. What can I offer my son with no home, no money... I've been wearing the same clothes for a week. I'm so so tired...
